evidence.unknown_preferences: bounded between minus one and plus one, never imputed ties
evidence.validity: both grounding gates and calibrated distinct recorded judge families
evidence.disagreement: inconclusive, not a tie or win
evidence.inference: exploratory panel preference; no general or human quality superiority claim
